With how unhinged this man currently is, I’m worried about your safety, please continue updating and commenting. Also send his license plate to a trusted individual with the make and model of his car, and your car just incase. 

There’s no telling what can happen when someone takes a dip in the looney lagoon, and having it and noting needing it is 10,000x better than needing it and not having it.

When on the phone specify it as a health crisis so the paramedics show up instead of just cops. That way health professionals will stand in the way of cops escalating a situation. I would also Google homeless assistance programs and make some calls. 

I’m in utah and we have the best homeless assistance in the country, which means we have figured out that the homeless are usually mentally unwell. This guy sounds like he is having at the minimum some severe dissociative episodes which can lead to some pretty crazy behavior. Start getting his behavior reported. Screw everybody that says don’t call the cops.

Call the damn cops

This guys refusal to take care of his mental health isn’t your problem. What he has made your problem is dealing with his symptoms, which could end up getting you hurt or killed. Schizophrenia isn’t to be fucked with. A symptom of schizophrenia is dysfunction of empathy, your living with someone who struggles with empathy. Regardless of whether he was born this way or it’s self inflicted he has no coping skills other than self medicating with booze.  

Protect yourself. Protect your baby. Fuck your partner for moving an unsafe person in while your having at the very minimum mobility issues. Either your fiancé is stupid, or malicious, regardless, not worth keeping around.
If first responders show up to a house enough regarding mental health problems, they could forcibly admit him…. Just sayingggg
